glossary.label: Why don't families understand?
glossary.body: Abusers deliberately sever a victim's support network over time, meaning when a victim finally seeks help, family members (unaware of the hidden abuse and combined with the societal shame of "failing a relationship") often minimize the danger or urge them to "work it out."
